title: Cinematic Muse Ascending
description: A woman in a red jacket and blue skirt levitates above a grand stone staircase inside a ruined circular theater. She reaches upward toward floating film reels, film strips, and movie stills while film equipment and broken film reels lie scattered on the stairs around her.
prompt: A woman with elaborate dark hair wearing a red jacket and flowing blue skirt floats above a crumbling stone staircase inside a vast ruined circular theater with frescoed walls. She reaches toward floating vintage film reels, film strips and movie stills suspended in the air. Broken film equipment and reels are scattered across the stairs. Dramatic beams of light shine from above through a broken dome revealing a purple dusk sky, cinematic surreal composition, highly detailed digital painting
